name: browser-devtools
description: Headless browser MCP — validate 7-position layout, WCAG, console errors in real browser

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a URL and wait for network idle.

tools.name: get_console_errors
tools.description: Return all console.error and console.warning entries since navigation. Critical for runtime validation.

tools.name: get_network_failures
tools.description: Return all failed network requests (4xx/5xx) since navigation.

tools.name: audit_wcag
tools.description: Run axe-core WCAG 2.1 AA audit. Returns violations with element selectors.

tools.name: check_layout_7pos
tools.description: Verify the page uses the 7 canonical layout positions (header, featuredContent, column_left, main, column_right, featuredFooter, footer). Returns which are present/missing.

tools.name: check_sticky_footer
tools.description: Verify footer sticks to bottom on short pages and is pushed down on long pages (no floating gap).

tools.name: check_palette
tools.description: Scan computed styles and verify the Apple Light Mode palette (Regla P5). Flags !important usage and out-of-palette colors.

tools.name: set_viewport
tools.description: Set viewport size for responsive testing (mobile-first).

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element by selector and wait for navigation/network idle.

tools.name: type
tools.description: Type text into an input by selector.
